items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: the Lee Collins records with Jones, which you made with Dave Jones too. ... I played with the band regularly.

ctx.x: I didn't think so either from the records.

They wrote a lot of good composers. No, they wrote a lot of good tunes and they had another one that used to be with him, George Jones, he played piano. He wasn't much of a piano player. Well he wrote a couple of tunes with Williams and he was up there with Williams when they had two music stores. They had one at 30 Foison State, one at 47 and they stayed there and finally they went to New York. And Clarence Williams, Foison used to play drum around here, then he started playing piano and he's a comedian. Then he…
Oh yeah, Professor Minetta said he had played up there once.
